a_text: Let's start with the core problem in sequence models.
b_text: Every token needs a way to relate to distant tokens.

a_text: The mechanism that solves this is called attention.
b_text: Each token computes a score against every other token.

a_text: That gives you a rich representation, but it has a cost.
b_text: The cost is quadratic in the length of the sequence.

a_text: So for long documents this becomes the bottleneck.
b_text: Several methods try to approximate the full attention matrix.

a_text: Sparse attention is one option, low rank approximation is another.
b_text: Each trades some accuracy for a lot of speed.

a_text: That's the tradeoff at the heart of efficient transformers.
b_text: Thanks for listening, that's the whole idea.
